about_the_game:
GHOST CAM is a haunting ghost photography VR and PC experience where you search for spirits to capture—but what happens if a ghost captures you? 👀

Armed with a paranormal-detecting camera and a torch, you’ll explore an abandoned bedroom that twists into a shifting labyrinth of secrets.

  • Hunt for ghosts and capture them on film.

  • Piece together a hidden story lurking beneath the surface.

  • Beware—some spirits don’t like to be seen.

  • The deeper you go, the more the world warps around you.

  • What kind of ghost expert will you become… and what will you uncover along the way?



👻 Test Your Ghost Photography Skills

Wield your Polaroid-style camera to capture spirits and uncover ghostly traces, earning a Ghost Hunter ranking based on your actions.

🌙 ’70s/’80s Haunted Horse Girl Aesthetic

Roam through a surreal blend of childhood horse obsession, heartache, and vintage horror. Set in liminal spaces where faded ribbons, dusty stables, and ghostly hoofbeats, the past lingers like a restless spirit.

🏚️ A Twisting, Haunted Dreamscape

Explore shifting liminal spaces, but beware— as the spirits can turn the dreamscapes into nightmares.

🔍 Puzzle-Filled Ghost Hunt

Use your camera to uncover hidden clues, piece together spectral remnants, and solve haunting escape-room-style puzzles to go deeper.

👀 Encounters with Many Spirits

Not all ghosts are hostile. Some watch, some guide, and some trap you in their world—if the spirits let you, you’ll unravel the truth beneath the surface.

📸 Multiple Endings & Replayability

Your choices matter—different actions unlock new paths, ghost rankings, and hidden mysteries waiting to be discovered.
detailed_description:
Celebrate Women's Day with us!!

We are thrilled to be officially selected as part of the Women's Day Sale organised by WINGS!

As a woman-led indie studio are delighted GHOST CAM has be chosen to be featured as an Upcoming Game and in such excellent company as the amazing array of women-led games - with some very tempting discounts!

We'd love to stay in touch with our ghost hunters so join our haunted Discord for secret updates and earlier access to our demo! 

And follow us on TikTok, Instagram and X.

name: GHOST CAM

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-8100, 3.60GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon™ RX 480
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Open XR
  • Additional Notes: Minimum Specs are for VR, lower specs may work for Non-VR.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Your camera sees what your eyes cannot. Explore eerie liminal spaces, capture spirits before they capture you, and unravel a haunting mystery. But beware—the deeper you go, the more the world distorts, and some ghosts will do anything to remain unseen.
